newsitem.title: USA: TIG Holdings, ups div, raises stock buyback.
newsitem.headline: TIG Holdings, ups div, raises stock buyback.

text.p: TIG Holdings Inc Thursday said it raised its common stock dividend to $0.15 per share from $0.05, payable on February 18, 1997 to shareholders of record on January 31, 1997.
The company also announced that its board has authorized an additional increase of 2.5 million shares in the its common stock repurchase program for a total of 13,750,000 shares.
The original authorization was announced in March 1994 and has been followed by nine subsequent increases, including today's announcement.

The company said it has repurchased 10,577,700 common shares to date, or 17 percent of the common shares outstanding at the program's inception, at an aggregate cost of $285 milllion, or $26.96 per common share.
TIG Holdings currently has 54,051,685 common shares outstanding, net of treasury shares, it said.
